title: Unit 11 Consolidation: The Unconscious, Dreams & Inner Conflict

sections.title: Consolidation Goals
items: I can accurately contrast transitive (-ít/-tat) and middle/intransitive (-ul/-ül/-ódik/-szik) psychological verbs
I can use behavioral -kodik/-kedik and brooding -ódik/-ődik verbs with their required case suffixes
I can deploy inflected reflexive pronouns (magát, magába, önmagával) with definite verb conjugation and Unit 11's psychological vocabulary
